title: Application for Anticipatory Bail under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023
whenToUse: Use when a client has a genuine and reasonable apprehension of arrest in a non-bailable cognizable case before the Court of Session or High Court under Section 482 BNSS, 2023.
variantComparisonNote: Pre-arrest protective remedy under Section 482 BNSS. Distinct from regular post-arrest bail under Section 480/483 BNSS.
youWillNeed: Copy of FIR (if available) or complaint, police notice under Section 35(3) BNSS, proof of residence and roots in society, medical certificates if applicable.
legalBasis: Section 482 Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (BNSS); Gurbaksh Singh Sibbia v. State of Punjab (1980); Sushila Aggarwal v. State (NCT of Delhi) (2020).
mandatoryStatutoryIngredients: Reasonable belief and tangible apprehension of arrest in non-bailable offense
Absence of flight risk and deep roots in society
Willingness to join and cooperate with investigation under Section 482(2) BNSS
Undertaking not to tamper with evidence or influence witnesses

particulars.label: Court Designation
particulars.description: Court of Session or High Court

particulars.label: Applicant Name
particulars.description: Full name of person seeking pre-arrest bail

particulars.label: FIR / Complaint Number
particulars.description: FIR number or preliminary enquiry reference

aiBlocks.title: Apprehension of Arrest & Case Background
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Detail genesis of false allegations, registration or threat of FIR No. {{FACT:fir_number}}, oblique political/commercial motive, and imminent apprehension of custodial arrest.

aiBlocks.title: Grounds Warranting Pre-Arrest Protection
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Articulate clean antecedents, lack of custodial requirement, purely documentary nature of investigation, deep societal roots, and satisfaction of Sushila Aggarwal constitutional benchmarks.

aiBlocks.title: Prayer for Pre-Arrest Bail & Interim Protection
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Draft comprehensive prayer for direction that in the event of arrest in FIR No. {{FACT:fir_number}}, Applicant be enlarged on bail, with ad-interim ex-parte protection pending notice.
